plugin.name: Splinter Cell Blacklist Fusion Fix
MAIN.SkipPressStart.description: Skips the "Press Any Key" screen and checkpoint selection.
MAIN.TurnSpeed.description: How fast Sam turns toward the movement direction while moving (0.5-10), 1.0 = default.
MAIN.SwapShoulderKey.description: Key that moves the camera over Sam's other shoulder while on foot, aiming included. Cover and human shields keep the game's own camera side. Empty = no key.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Scale locomotion camera FOV from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 keeps the normal view. Aim, scopes, gadgets and authored cameras keep their own FOV. The final horizontal gameplay view stays within 150 degrees; native camera smoothing is preserved.
MAIN.ScreenCullBias.description: 0.0 provides the best draw distance. The default value (1.0) causes distant objects to disappear.
MAIN.DisableNightVisionFlash.description: Remove the white flash when switching night vision on.
MAIN.DisablePerfectionistChecks.descript: Allow Mark and Execute and related UI on Perfectionist difficulty.
MAIN.DefaultMissionFilter.description: Choose the mission filter selected when opening the SMI map.
MAIN.SMIMapDisableStartupAnimation.descr: Skip the initial SMI map animation.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Change the frame rate limit immediately. Use 0 for unlimited, -1 for the current monitor refresh rate, or 30–1000 FPS. Turn off native Vertical Sync for rates above refresh. Some NPCs can show double images above 100 FPS.
UNLOCKS.UnlockDLC.description: Unlocks all DLC content that can no longer be obtained due to server shutdown.
UNLOCKS.UnlockAllNonCampaignMissions.des: Unlocks all 4th Echelon missions from the start.
UNLOCKS.UnlockAllCampaignMissions.descri: Unlocks all campaign missions from the start.
EXTRACTION.ExtractionWaveConfigs.descrip: Default uses the game's waves, with the enemy multiplier. Random multiplies the number of each enemy by a random number between the minimum and maximum for each spawn.
EXTRACTION.ExtractionWaveEnemyMultiplier: Multiplies the number of enemies in each wave when using the Default config.
EXTRACTION.ExtractionWaveEnemyRandomRang: Extraction Wave Enemy Random Range Min
Minimum random multiplier for each enemy spawn in Random waves.
Extraction Wave Enemy Random Range Max
Maximum random multiplier for each enemy spawn in Random waves.
EXTRACTION.EnableKobinAndGrimMaps.descri: Adds Charlie versions of Kobins and Grims missions to the SMI map (they do not affect progress or stats).
EXTRACTION.EnableCoopCampaignMaps.descri: Adds Charlie versions of the co-op campaigns 4 missions to the SMI map (they do not affect progress or stats).
KESTREL.EnableKestrelDLC.description: Adds the 4 missions of the cut Kestrel DLC to the SMI map (they do not affect progress or stats).
HUNTER.ReinforcementsNumber.description: Use the original reinforcement count or a random count between the configured minimum and maximum.
HUNTER.ReinforcementsEnemyMultiplier.des: Multiplies the number of reinforcements when using the Default config.
HUNTER.ReinforcementsEnemyRandomRangeMin: Minimum number of reinforcements with the Random configuration.
HUNTER.ReinforcementsEnemyRandomRangeMax: Maximum number of reinforcements with the Random configuration.
GHOST.DisableMissionFailOnDetection.desc: The mission does not fail when the player is detected.
COOP.ReinforcementsNumber.description: Use the original reinforcement count or a random count between the configured minimum and maximum.
COOP.ReinforcementsEnemyMultiplier.descr: Multiplies the number of reinforcements when using the Default config.
COOP.ReinforcementsEnemyRandomRangeMin.d: Minimum number of reinforcements with the Random configuration.
COOP.ReinforcementsEnemyRandomRangeMax.d: Maximum number of reinforcements with the Random configuration. Too high a value can make the final mission impossible to complete.
COOP.DisableMissionFailOnDetection.descr: The mission does not fail when the player is detected (where applicable).
CAMPAIGN.DisableMissionFailOnDetection.d: The mission does not fail when the player is detected (where applicable).
CAMPAIGN.EnableRunDuringForcedWalk.descr: Allows you to run during forced walk sections.
LOGITECH.LightSyncRGB.description: Applies the selected suit indicator color to mouse and keyboard lighting. Only Logitech hardware is supported. Requires the Logitech G HUB app.
SPLITSCREEN.Enable.description: Restore local split screen co-op. Player 2 needs a gamepad. Player 2 START opens and closes pause; player 1 controls that menu.
SPLITSCREEN.GamepadPlayer1.description: Gamepad of player 1 (1-4, 0 = keyboard and mouse only while player 2 is in, single player is not affected).
FILELOADER.DumpPackedFiles.description: Unpacks the contents of all .umd archives into an 'unpacked' folder next to the exe (see _dump.log in it), move the files to 'update' to load them from disk instead of the archives.
STARTUP.DedicatedServerExePath.descripti: Optional dedicated server executable path, absolute or relative to the game executable. It starts with the game and closes when the game exits.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the local single-player world while the game window is unfocused. Changes apply immediately. Existing pauses stay intact; online worlds keep their native behavior.
startup.unsupported: This game executable is not supported, or the native Plugins menu could not be installed. Fusion Fix has been disabled. Use a supported, unmodified game executable.
MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Use raw mouse movement for camera look, bypassing Windows pointer speed and acceleration. Mouse counts are accumulated between frames, preserving movement from high polling rate mice. Off restores the native mouse input. Menu cursor movement is unchanged. Applies immediately.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor. Applies immediately.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
update.title: Update available
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Auto uses Xbox artwork. Choose PlayStation or Nintendo artwork manually. Native Flash caches prompt images, so changing this setting requires a restart.
CutsceneBorders.description: Framing of the cinematics, made for a 16:9 picture. Letterbox keeps the original bars on screens narrower than 16:9, Pillarbox puts bars at the sides of wider screens, Both does both. Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places side HUD elements at the screen edges. Choose 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 or a custom W:H or decimal ratio to keep them in a centered area, from 4:3 to 32:9. Full-screen effects and world markers are unchanged. Applies immediately.
